title: St Mark's Parishioners, Siddal, Halifax - WW1 and WW2
memorial_details:
description: 6 O'CLOCK FACE OF MEMORIAL, TOP: IS IT NOTHING TO YOU/ ALL YE THAT PASS BY

6 O'CLOCK FACE OF MEMORIAL, BOTTOM: IN GRATEFUL MEMORY OF/ EVERY PARISHIONER IN/ ST MARK'S PARISH, SIDDAL,/ WHO FELL IN THE GREAT/ WAR 1914 - 1918 AND IN/ HEARTFELT THANKS FOR/ ALL WHO RETURNED SAFELY

ADDITIONAL BRONZE PLAQUE IN CENTRE OF MEMORIAL'S 6 O'CLOCK FACE:  ALSO/ TO THE MEMORY OF THOSE OF/ SIDDAL/ WHO MADE THE SUPREME SACRIFICE IN/ WORLD WAR II 1939 - 1945/ "WE SHALL REMEMBER THEM"/
